decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program costs little to keep as a service option, but it overlaps with the other express offers and could be consolidated, so the option stays open for now.
The seventy-two-hour delivery is costly to sustain operationally, yet with demand still uncertain and the program only recently launched, keeping the option open is justified.
This European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends a core modular system, was showcased at BAU, and costs little to keep, which makes it a strong option worth further commitment.
The umbrella express program has its own page and supports the firm's fast-response strategy, so the evidence so far favors keeping it.
The digital ordering platform is a strategic option for trade partners that is cheap to maintain once built and whose value is still unfolding.
The fire and smoke protection door fits the firm's core compliance-driven portfolio, has low marginal cost, and serves steady regulatory demand.
